Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for the time today — good to hear more about BluePeak's ingestion patterns and the latency targets you need for batch and near-real-time inference. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

- Demo/technical deep-dive: show how Redwood handles your 2–4 second p99 target with KV caching and autoscaling.
- Security evidence: your security team asked for SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, and network allowlist template.
- Procurement: Samir will drive the purchasing path; we should surface any PO / SOW requirements early.

To keep scheduling simple, here are 3 windows (all in ET) for a 60–75m deep dive where our infra and security leads can join: 
- Tue 19 May — 10:00–11:15 ET
- Wed 20 May — 14:00–15:15 ET
- Thu 21 May — 08:30–09:45 ET

If none of those work, share two 60–75m windows that do. I'll loop in Monica (security) and Markus (platform) once we lock a time so the right folks are present.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2-onepage.pdf (SOC 2 scope + high-level controls). I also attached a Network-Allowlist-Template.csv to speed up your infra review.

Proposed owner for mutual action plan: Hannah (Redwood) + Samir (BluePeak). If Samir wants to propose a different owner, happy to adopt.

Short asks from you in the reply: 1) which demo window works, 2) list of internal stakeholders we should invite (security, infra, procurement contacts), 3) any procurement timing constraints (quarter-end PO deadlines, vendors list).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Hannah
